tools.name: tito_whoami
tools.description: Confirm the API token works and list the account slugs it can reach, plus its lookup mode (live or test — a token only sees tickets and registrations of its own mode). Call this first to discover account_slug. Tito: GET /hello.

tools.name: tito_list_events
tools.description: List an account's events: upcoming (default), past or archived. Each has its slug, title, dates, location, currency, live/test_mode flags and public URL. Tito: GET /:account/events, /events/past, /events/archived.

tools.name: tito_get_event
tools.description: Fetch a single event by slug: title, description, dates and times, time zone, location, currency, live/test_mode, and its releases. Tito: GET /:account/:event.

tools.name: tito_list_releases
tools.description: List an event's releases — Tito's ticket types — with price, quantity, tickets_count sold, sold_out / off_sale / secret flags, sale window and share_url. Tito: GET /:account/:event/releases.

tools.name: tito_get_release
tools.description: Fetch a single release (ticket type) by slug, with pricing, capacity, sales counts (full-price, discounted, free, voided), questions and activities. Tito: GET /:account/:event/releases/:release_slug.

tools.name: tito_list_tickets
tools.description: List an event's tickets — one per attendee — newest first, with name, email, company, reference, release, price paid and state. Filter by free text (name, email, phone, reference, company, tag), state, type, release, activity, and created/updated time. Void tickets are excluded unless states include

tools.name: tito_get_ticket
tools.description: Fetch a single ticket by slug (ti_...), with the attendee, registration, release, question answers, tags and amounts paid. Tito: GET /:account/:event/tickets/:ticket_slug.

tools.name: tito_list_registrations
tools.description: List an event's registrations — Tito's orders — newest first, with buyer name/email, reference, total, state, paid/refunded flags, discount code and ticket quantities. Filter by free text (email, name, slug, reference, company, discount code), state, and created/updated time. Cancelled ones are excl

tools.name: tito_get_registration
tools.description: Fetch a single registration (order) by slug (reg_...), with its tickets, receipts, refunds, line items, billing address and payment details. Tito: GET /:account/:event/registrations/:registration_slug.

tools.name: tito_list_discount_codes
tools.description: List an event's discount codes with code, type (PercentOffDiscountCode / MoneyOffDiscountCode), value, quantity and quantity_used, validity window and attached releases. Tito: GET /:account/:event/discount_codes.

tools.name: tito_get_discount_code
tools.description: Fetch a single discount code by its numeric id, including how many times it has been used. Tito: GET /:account/:event/discount_codes/:discount_code_id.

tools.name: tito_list_activities
tools.description: List an event's activities — sessions, workshops or dinners beyond the ticket itself — with capacity, allocation_count, sold_out, date/times and attached releases. Tito: GET /:account/:event/activities.

tools.name: tito_list_questions
tools.description: List the custom questions an event asks attendees (e.g. dietary requirements, t-shirt size) with slug, field_type, required flag and answers_count. Use a question's slug with tito_list_answers. Tito: GET /:account/:event/questions.

tools.name: tito_list_answers
tools.description: List every attendee's answer to one question, each with its ticket_id and the response text. Tito: GET /:account/:event/questions/:question_slug/answers.

tools.name: tito_list_checkin_lists
tools.description: List an event's check-in lists (the door lists used at the venue) with title, slug, the releases/activities they cover and which attendee fields they show. Tito: GET /:account/:event/checkin_lists.

tools.name: tito_list_refunds
tools.description: List the refunds recorded for an event, each with amount, created_at, whether it was manual, and the registration it belongs to. Read-only: this server never issues refunds. Tito: GET /:account/:event/refunds.

tools.name: tito_create_discount_code
tools.description: Create a discount code for an event. type is PercentOffDiscountCode (value = percent) or MoneyOffDiscountCode (value = flat amount off per ticket, in the event currency). Undo by editing it (e.g. quantity or end_at) with tito_update_discount_code. Tito: POST /:account/:event/discount_codes.

tools.name: tito_update_discount_code
tools.description: Change an existing discount code — its code, value, quantity, validity window or attached releases. Only the fields you pass are sent. To retire a code without deleting it, set end_at to now. Tito: PATCH /:account/:event/discount_codes/:discount_code_id.

tools.name: tito_create_ticket
tools.description: Issue a ticket for a release without a checkout — e.g. a speaker, sponsor or comp ticket. Tito creates a manual registration for it. This creates a real ticket that counts against the release's capacity (undo only by voiding it in the Tito dashboard). Tito: POST /:account/:event/tickets.

tools.name: tito_update_ticket
tools.description: Correct a ticket's attendee details — name, email, company, phone, tags or metadata. Only the fields you pass are sent, and no email is sent to anyone (unlike a reassignment, which this server does not do). Tito: PATCH /:account/:event/tickets/:ticket_slug.

findings.detail: Description of "tito_list_releases" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tito_whoami, tito_list_events, tito_list_releases, tito_get_release, tito_list_tickets, tito_get_ticket, tito_list_registrations, tito_get_registration, tito_list_activities, tito_list_refunds · Private data: tito_whoami, tito_list_releases · Public sink: tito_list_tickets, tito_list_registrations, tito_create_discount_code, tito_create_ticket, tito_update_ticket.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tito_whoami, tito_list_events, tito_list_releases, tito_get_release, tito_list_tickets, tito_get_ticket, tito_list_registrations, tito_get_registration, tito_list_activities, tito_list_refunds · Private data: tito_whoami, tito_list_releases · Public sink: tito_list_tickets, tito_list_registrations, tito_create_discount_code, tito_create_ticket, tito_update_ticket

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
